package_info:
Name: sample-numeric-core
Version: 1.4.0
Summary: Numeric computing core with C/Cython extensions (numpy-like)
Home-page: https://github.com/example/sample-numeric-core
License: BSD-3-Clause
Requires-Python: >=3.10

Build:
- Build-backend: setuptools.build_meta
- setup.py defines ext_modules for sample_numeric_core._ufuncs (C) and sample_numeric_core._cython_blas (Cython)
- Links against BLAS and LAPACK (OpenBLAS or system BLAS)
- Requires C compiler (gcc/clang), Cython, and BLAS/LAPACK devel packages at build time
- Published wheels: manylinux2014_x86_64 and macosx_11_0_arm64 (no py3-none-any)
- Optional OpenMP for parallel ufuncs
- Native extension package; source builds need compilers and math libraries
jira_context: Investigate sample-numeric-core for RHAI packaging; expect native build complexity.
